value.rationale: Global convergence toward the invariant diagonal despite instability of the diagonal equilibrium is not inferable from local bifurcation or synchronous Floquet stability. The explicit nonempty open wedge for h>2 excludes all off-diagonal positive attractors and gives an orbit-dependent exponential rate, which addresses coexistence versus synchronization when the scalar coordinate need not settle. No optimal threshold claim.
